description: READ an existing TD network's topology and WRITE it as an Obsidian note: a Mermaid flowchart plus [[wikilinks]] for every operator and connection, so the vault's graph view becomes a clickable map of the patch. The note (Networks/<path>.md by default) is fully rewritten on each call. Use this to persist a browsable map in the vault; use document_network to get the same documentation back as a tool result without touching the vault. Returns the note path and the node/connection counts (and whether output was truncated). Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

recursive.description: Include all descendants (otherwise just the direct children).

name: export_network_to_vault
title: Export network docs to the vault
